# Version 4.150.2
> **GPU reliability updates** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 brings additional Skia m150 reliability fixes to GPU rendering and SkSL. The servicing update improves failed-flush and resolve handling, prevents stale GPU readbacks, corrects Imagination framebuffer cleanup, and fixes RasterPipeline code generation.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh recovers correctly from failed GPU work** — Failed flushes no longer return stale readbacks, dropped resolve tasks restore dirty tracking, and Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion is corrected. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **SkSL RasterPipeline code generation is safer** — Updates the bundled Skia engine with an upstream fix for a use-after-free during RasterPipeline code generation. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))
- **Additional Skia m150 fixes are included** — Refreshes the bundled release-line engine with a further upstream m150 bug-fix sync. ([#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

HarfBuzzSharp advances from 14.2.1.1 to 14.2.1.2 alongside this SkiaSharp servicing release.
